narrative.details:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
narrative.offerRewardText: Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned!Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
